description: This file declares the GpxParser class responsible for parsing .gpx files and extracting GPS fixes, providing static methods for both file-based and string-based parsing.

classes.name: GpxParser
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to parse GPX files and strings to extract GPS fixes.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a specified .gpx file to extract GPS fixes into a provided array, returning success status and error messages if applicable.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses an input string containing GPX data to extract GPS fixes into a provided array, returning success status and error messages if applicable.
